sample: 40 random wrong answers from equal-mass groups 1 to 3 (457 total)

items.text: How do I know when my card will arrive?
items.reason: Arrival and delivery estimate both fit.

items.text: Is there tracking info available?
items.reason: Tracking fits arrival or delivery estimate.

items.text: I need my card as soon as possible.
items.reason: Wanting the card fast fits arrival or estimate.

items.text: Change currency
items.reason: Could mean exchanging money or account currency support.

items.text: Can I change my currency from USD to EUR?
items.reason: Could mean exchanging or currency support.

items.text: what is required documents for new card process ?
items.reason: Nothing about contactless; asks about ordering a card.

items.text: I made an error in payment yesterday and I need it fixed asap because it's for my rent tomorrow.
items.reason: User made the error; nothing failed.

items.text: Is there a reason why my transaction is taking so long?
items.reason: Slow transaction fits timing or not received.

items.text: If I only have 1 other US card, can you take it?
items.reason: Asks if a US card is accepted; topping up is a fair reading.

items.text: Will you accept my other card from the U.S.?
items.reason: Asks if the bank accepts their card, not where the card works.

items.text: Is my currency okay to add money with?
items.reason: Currency for adding money fits either.

items.text: Why would my top up be cancelled?
items.reason: Cancelled top up fits reverted or failed.

items.text: do I need to verify my identity every time I log into my account?
items.reason: Policy question could be why or how to verify.

items.text: The app will not let me into my account.
items.reason: Locked out; neither label is clearly right.

items.text: Where in the app can I find my PIN?
items.reason: Finding a PIN is not changing it.

items.text: I just got my new card but am not sure how to check its PIN.
items.reason: Checking a new card PIN is not changing it.

items.text: i know i entered the right info, but my top up isn't in my balance
items.reason: Top up missing from balance fits pending top up; card detail fits the dataset label.

items.text: Is it possible to use my credit card to transfer money?
items.reason: Credit card to move money fits top up or transfer in.

items.text: I need to create several disposable cards per day.
items.reason: "Several per day" is about limits.

items.text: Can I dispute a payment even if I notice it several weeks after it was made?
items.reason: No mention of direct debit or card.

items.text: My withdrawal was cancelled.
items.reason: Cancelled withdrawal is declined, not pending.

items.text: Why didn't the ATM give me my money?
items.reason: ATM not paying out fits declined withdrawal or ATM support.

items.text: I have waited 15 days, but my payment still hasn't cleared.
items.reason: "Payment" not cleared fits card payment or transfer.

items.text: the app reverted my payment
items.reason: A payment, not a top up.

items.text: My card payment was cancelled.
items.reason: Cancelled card payment fits reverted or declined.

items.text: what happens to the funds if a merchant refuses the payment
items.reason: Merchant refusing fits declined or reverted.

items.text: I'm not sure why my card payment was cancelled, can you find out why?
items.reason: Cancelled card payment fits reverted or declined.

items.text: I've transferred money before without issue but now I am encountering an error stating that it isn't possible. Why is that?
items.reason: Transfer error with no reason given fits both.

items.text: The money would not transfer to a beneficiary.
items.reason: Names the beneficiary explicitly.

items.text: Why did I receive an error message saying that my transfer was not possible?
items.reason: Transfer not possible, no beneficiary mentioned.

items.text: I receive my salary in GBP. Do I need to configure this somehwere?
items.reason: Salary in GBP fits receiving money or currency support.

items.text: How do I deposit my paycheck to this account?
items.reason: Paycheck could be a cheque deposit.

items.text: My daughter would like a card as well, how can we make this happen?
items.reason: A card for a family member is a spare card.

items.text: What locations can a card be delivered to?
items.reason: Delivery locations fit ordering or delivery estimate.

items.text: Why did the disposable virtual card which I used to pay a gym subscription get denied?
items.reason: Virtual card declined fits both.

items.text: My transaction was just declined when I was using my disposable virtual card. What can I do?
items.reason: Virtual card declined fits both.

items.text: I made a transfer a few hours ago from a UK banking account.  I do not yet see the transfer.  Please check on this for me.
items.reason: Transfer in not showing fits both.

items.text: Hello I made a bank transfer couple hours ago from my UK account but it doesn't show up yet. Can you please check if everything is alright with it?
items.reason: Transfer in not showing fits both.

items.text: How do I cancel my card? There are charges on my account that I didn't make.
items.reason: Unrecognised charges, not withdrawals.

items.text: My top up is not working in Apple Pay.
items.reason: Apple Pay top up failing fits both.
